title: error summary plus per field
name: Error summary plus per field — GOV.UK
rule: Error summary + per-field errors + focus the summary + link each item to the answer. GOV.UK requires the summary as well.
pass_when: On submit errors: a summary is focused, each summary item links to its answer, and each field also has its error.
fail_when: Summary only (no per-field); per-field only (no summary on this pattern); summary not focused; items don’t link to answers.
overview: On submit errors, show a focused summary plus per-field errors with links to answers.
apply_when: Handling validation failures after a form submit on a GOV.UK-style page.
not_when: Not for live inline hints before submit, or non-form status toasts.
agent_hint: Focus an error summary, link each item to its field, and keep per-field errors.
description: After submit errors, provide both an error summary and per-field errors. Focus the summary, and link each summary item to its answer. Summary-only or field-only patterns miss the requirement; GOV.UK needs the summary as well as field messages. Fail if the summary is missing, fields lack errors, the summary is not focused, or items do not link to answers.
do_not_claim: A winner vs Vercel focus-first-field (`forms.errors.focus_first_error`); Polar banner (dual-cite, see `polar.long-form-errors-banner-plus-inline`). Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.next_to_field_not_summary_only` + `forms.errors.focus_first_error`. Compatible with “not summary-only”; do not drop the summary.
